hook.say: Eight neighbours, five questions. Almost nobody knows which border is the shortest. Do you?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which of these countries does NOT border Türkiye?
questions.say: Which of these countries does not border Turkey?
questions.fact: Türkiye has eight land neighbours. Romania is across the Black Sea.
questions.sayAnswer: Romania! Turkey has 8 land neighbours, and Romania lies across the Black Sea.

questions.q: Which eastern neighbour of Türkiye is this?
questions.say: Which eastern neighbour of Turkey is this?
questions.fact: Iran borders Türkiye in the east, not far from Mount Ararat.
questions.sayAnswer: Iran! It borders Turkey in the east, not far from Mount Ararat.

questions.q: With which country does Türkiye share its longest land border?
questions.say: With which country does Turkey share its longest land border?
questions.fact: The border with Syria stretches for more than 800 kilometres.
questions.sayAnswer: Syria! That border stretches for more than 800 kilometres.

questions.q: The Meriç (Maritsa) river forms much of Türkiye's border with whom?
questions.say: The Maritsa river forms much of Turkey's border with which country?
questions.fact: The river is called Meriç in Turkish and Evros in Greek.
questions.sayAnswer: Greece! The river is called Meh-rich in Turkish, and Evros in Greek.

questions.q: With which country does Türkiye share its shortest land border?
questions.say: With which country does Turkey share its shortest land border?
questions.fact: The border with Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan is less than 20 km long.
questions.sayAnswer: Azerbaijan! The border with its Nakhchivan region is less than 20 kilometres long.
